CustomField.description: Displays the Type of the Contact's Account. When the Type is Customer, shows Customer - User if Active Beacon Subscription is checked, otherwise Customer - Non-User. Blank when the Contact has no Account or the Account has no Type.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( Account.Type, "Customer" ), IF( Active_Beacon_Subscription__c, "Customer - User", "Customer - Non-User" ), TEXT( Account.Type ) )
CustomField.label: Customer Status
